title: Periodic mechanical transmission can invert a relaxation response only with a paid sensing and force interface
statement: A Maxwell gel in series with an output spring has H=i*omega*tau/[beta+i*omega*tau*(1+beta)] and direct-transmission force-stroke bound F*A_y<=G*V*epsilon_max^2/4. Thin ribbons can reduce diffusion time without reducing this minimum volume or oxygen inventory.

requires: The stated linear Maxwell/output-spring topology, sinusoidal strain bounded by epsilon_max, supplied G,V and beta>0; actual oxygen-dependent relaxation and port/pressure conditions are additional proposal requirements.
provides: A Maxwell gel in series with an output spring has H=i*omega*tau/[beta+i*omega*tau*(1+beta)] and direct-transmission force-stroke bound F*A_y<=G*V*epsilon_max^2/4. Thin ribbons can reduce diffusion time without reducing this minimum volume or oxygen inventory.
assumptions: No zero-frequency Maxwell support or spontaneous reset. The bound is topology-specific and does not apply to independent powered latches. Ligand/network kinetics and actual modulus are not inferred from stress-relaxation data.
costs: For direct transmission, V>=4*F*A_y/(G*epsilon_max^2) and oxygen charge>=B_max*Delta_s*V. Finite oxygen stores appear in work bounds. Static pressure-area mismatch, friction, membranes, gross clock work and sensor charging remain inclusive. The selected synthetic candidate buys its18/24 threshold count at about2.02times hydraulic power; informed ordinary valves support19/24 under the original power budget versus the candidate's12/24 continuous final-window count. Objectives differ and no practical advantage follows. Delay-sensitive regimes can lose continuous adequacy despite acceptable averages.
contract.units: q is volume/time, pressure p is force/area, hydraulic work is energy; tau is time and omega is inverse time. G is modulus, V is volume, F*A_y is energy, epsilon is dimensionless strain, B_max is bound oxygen amount/volume. Tissue uptake and synthetic thresholds are supplied model quantities.
contract.obstruction: Acquire an oxygen-to-stroke unit with threshold, ligand kinetics, load/force balance, total work, inventory and cyclic drift measured separately. Preserve source-reported benchmark/correction/delay failures; do not promote the mathematical oxygen threshold into a biological viability criterion or claim replay of absent physical data.

body: Solve the linear series constitutive equation to obtain H. With K0=G*A/L, U<=epsilon_max*L and Kv=beta*K0, F*A_y=Kv*|H|^2*U^2<=beta/(1+beta)^2*G*V*epsilon_max^2<=G*V*epsilon_max^2/4. Multiply minimum volume by bound-site capacity and saturation change for minimum oxygen charge. Ribbon subdivision preserves ideal axial area/volume while shortening lateral diffusion, but the reaction-diffusion eigenvalue approaches the finite ligand release rate as thickness vanishes. This supplies a conditional design budget, not a fabricated actuator.
